
one — workspace development

USAGE
  one <command> [options]

EVERYDAY COMMANDS
  create        Create a workspace
  add           Add a project
  dev           Start local development
  build         Build projects
  run           List and execute workspace tasks
  exec          Execute a command with project variables
  env           Manage environment variables
  login         Sign in to Infisical in your browser

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output  Output format: json | yaml | text
  -h, --help    Show help
  -v, --version Show version

EXAMPLES
  one create demo
  one add
  one dev
  one build -p web
  one test -p web

All commands: one help --all
Task shorthand: one <task> = one run <task> (built-ins take precedence)
Command help: one <command> --help
